issue_context.title: Polymorphic deserialization of a composite collection throws NullReferenceException
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-text-json, @gregsdennis See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
### Description If a `JsonDerivedType` of a `JsonPolymorphic` base class implements `ICollection` where T is the base class it will serialize as a JSON object with a `$type`property for the type discriminator and a `$values` property with an array of the items in the collection. This is all good. When deserializing however, a `NullReferenceException` it thrown. ### Reproduction Steps ``` using System.Collections; using System.Text.Json; using System.Text.Json.Serialization; namespace PolymorphicCollectionSerialization; [JsonPolymorphic] [JsonDerivedType(typeof(Composite), nameof(Composite))] public abstract class Base { } public class Composite : Base, ICollection { private readonly ICollection _items = new List(); // Implementation ICollection as delegation to _items public IEnumerator GetEnumerator() => _items.GetEnumerator(); IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => ((IEnumerable) _items).GetEnumerator(); public void Add(Base item) => _items.Add(item); public void Clear() => _items.Clear(); public bool Contains(Base item) => _items.Contains(item); public void CopyTo(Base[] array, int arrayIndex) => _items.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex); public bool Remove(Base item) => _items.Remove(item); public int Count => _items.Count; public bool IsReadOnly => _items.IsReadOnly; } public class Program { public static void Main(string[] args) { Base test = new Composite {new Composite(), new Composite()}; var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(test); Console.WriteLine(json); // {"$type":"Composite","$values":[{"$type":"Composite","$values":[]},{"$type":"Composite","$values":[]}]} var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(json) as Composite; // throws System.NullReferenceException Console.WriteLine($"{deserialized?.Count}"); // Expected: 2 } } ``` ### Expected behavior Serialization of the class works correctly, I would expect it to deserialize back to an equivalent object. ### Actual behavior The following exception is thrown ``` Unhandled exception. System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object. at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.LookupProperty(Object obj, ReadOnlySpan`1 unescapedPropertyName, ReadStack& state, JsonSerializerOptions options, Boolean& useExtensionProperty, Boolean createExtensionProperty) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.Converters.ObjectDefaultConverter`1.OnTryRead(Utf8JsonReader& reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, T& value) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1.TryRead(Utf8JsonReader& reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, T& value) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonCollectionConverter`2.OnTryRead(Utf8JsonReader& reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, TCollection& value) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1.OnTryReadAsObject(Utf8JsonReader& reader, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, Object& value) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.Converters.ObjectDefaultConverter`1.OnTryRead(Utf8JsonReader& reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, T& value) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1.TryRead(Utf8JsonReader& reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, T& value) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1.ReadCore(Utf8JsonReader& reader, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state) at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.ReadFromSpan[TValue](ReadOnlySpan`1 utf8Json, JsonTypeInfo jsonTypeInfo, Nullable`1 actualByteCount) at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.ReadFromSpan[TValue](ReadOnlySpan`1 json, JsonTypeInfo jsonTypeInfo) at PolymorphicCollectionSerialization.Program.Main(String[] args) in /Users/dangraham/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Source/PolymorphicCollectionSerialization/PolymorphicCollectionSerialization/Class1.cs:line 43 ``` ### Regression? I don't think so, Polymorphic Deserialization in System.Text.Json is new in .NET 7 ### Known Workarounds 1. Remove the ICollection implementation, replace with a property: ``` public class Composite : Base { public ICollection Items { get; } = new List(); } ``` 2. Implement a custom JsonConverter ### Configuration dotnet 7.0.100 macOS 13.3.1 (a) intel x64 ### Other information _No response_
Author: Nectivio
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-System.Text.Json`
Milestone: -

Appears to be a bug in how the `ReadStack` resolves the `JsonTypeInfo` for the nested polymorphic element. Instead of using `Base` it somehow defaults to `Composite` so it won't attempt to read any polymorphic metadata resulting in the exception. Issue reproduces in both .NET 7 and .NET 8.

review_comments: The crux of the fix is that this initialization was happening too early -- if the converter was run as part of a polymorphic re-entrancy this initialization would never be hit. I checked the other polymorphic converters and none have the same issue.
